verdict.rationale: Snyk documents dedicated scanners spanning open-source dependencies (with indirect/transitive dependency detection), SAST (Snyk Code) across IDEs/repos/CI, container images, and IaC configs (Terraform, CloudFormation, Kubernetes, ARM), plus a CLI usable locally, in IDEs, and in CI/CD — collectively covering the major ecosystems a typical org would need. Community feedback raises accuracy/noise concerns (e.g., mismatched results vs npm audit, PR spam) but does not concretely dispute the breadth of language/ecosystem coverage itself. Missing for 10: an explicit enumerated list of supported languages/package managers and independent verification of coverage completeness across less-common ecosystems.
